Part 5 · Another way
Derivation by factorising
Identity
a⁴ − b⁴ = (a − b)(a + b)(a² + b²)
So
T⁴ − T₀⁴ = (T − T₀)(T + T₀)(T² + T₀²)
T ≈ T₀
T + T₀ ≈ 2T₀ , T² + T₀² ≈ 2T₀²
T⁴ − T₀⁴ ≈ 4T₀³ (T − T₀)
Hence
−
dT
dt
≈ 4K T₀³ (T − T₀) ∝ (T − T₀)

Revision · Formula sheet 1
Newton’s law and the average method
Concept
Formula
Newton’s law of cooling
−dT/dt = k(T − Tₛ)
Rate of cooling
R = −dT/dt
Average rate of cooling
Rₐᵥ = (T₁ − T₂) / Δt
Average temperature
Tₐᵥ ≈ (T₁ + T₂) / 2
Average-temperature method
(T₁ − T₂)/Δt ≈ k[(T₁ + T₂)/2 − Tₛ]
Exponential cooling
T(t) = Tₛ + (Tᵢ − Tₛ)e⁻ᵏᵗ
Exact time interval
Δt = (1/k) ln[(T₁ − Tₛ)/(T₂ − Tₛ)]

Small difference

Newtonian cooling constant
k = 4εσAT₀³ / mc

Correct idea
